journeys.description: Validate the Migration 1048 recovery definition and safety markers without applying the migration.

tests.command: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs';const p='http-generic-api/migrations/1048_transport_response_chunk_schema_recovery.sql';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const required=['-- no_provider_call','-- no_credential_payload_read','-- no_raw_secrets','-- no_external_send','-- no_external_write','-- secrets_included_false','CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS governed_tool_response_chunks','owner_tenant_id VARCHAR(64)','owner_user_id VARCHAR(64)','owner_workspace_id VARCHAR(64)','owner_principal_type VARCHAR(64)','owner_principal_id VARCHAR(191)','source_surface VARCHAR(64)','idx_governed_chunk_owner_user_expiry','idx_governed_chunk_principal_expiry','CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_governed_response_chunk_transport_schema_readiness','16 AS required_column_count','0 AS secrets_included'];const missing=required.filter((value)=>!s.includes(value));if(missing.length){console.error(JSON.stringify({status:'fail',migration:p,missing}));process.exit(1)}console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'pass',migration:p,checks:required.length,applied:false}))"
